Method of Attack: Abuse of legitimate SaaS platforms to host phishing websites that steal login credentials
Hosting credential stealing pages directly on the abused services
Using redirection from landing pages hosted on abused services to bulletproof phishing sites
Evading email security alerts, enjoying high availability, and bypassing coding requirements
Attack Vector: Phishing emails containing URLs to malicious SaaS-hosted pages
Redirection from SaaS-hosted landing pages to bulletproof phishing sites
Indicators of Compromise: URLs from abused SaaS platforms such as typeform.com, 123formbuilder.com, formtools.com, smartsurvey.co.uk, Canva.com
